cases.input: Prepare a management review for a marketed IVD using a complete pms-management-review-input.json and a management-review-return-input.json from the prior review. The return input contains one verified closed action, one implemented action still awaiting effectiveness evidence, and one open high-impact action.
requiredBehaviors: consume the aggregated PMS management-review input, preserve specialist decision references and keep no-events, no-signal, no-data, not-reviewed and not-applicable states distinct
surface unresolved high-impact postmarket or vigilance states even when aggregate KPIs are otherwise green and qualify QMS conclusions where the evidence requires it
keep time-critical vigilance, reportability and field-action escalation independent of the scheduled management-review cadence
consume the prior management-review return input when earlier actions exist and keep implemented, effectiveness-pending, effective, external-pending and closed action states distinct
forbiddenBehaviors: re-decide specialist-owned reportability or external closure merely because the case was discussed in management review
copy unnecessary patient-level or raw complaint case data into the management-review brief
upgrade an implemented or owner-completed prior action to effective or closed without the required evidence

cases.input: The overall complaint KPI is within target, but one potentially serious unresolved vigilance case exists, one major PMS source was not reviewed, and a prior management action was implemented but its effectiveness observation window has not finished. Build the management-review conclusion.
requiredBehaviors: keep the unresolved higher-risk case visible as a management-attention item instead of averaging it away under the aggregate KPI
mark the unreviewed PMS source as a data gap and qualify suitability, adequacy or effectiveness conclusions rather than interpreting missing coverage positively
keep the prior implemented action open as effectiveness-pending until specialist effectiveness evidence exists
forbiddenBehaviors: declare postmarket governance adequate solely because the aggregate complaint KPI is green
treat a not-reviewed source as evidence of zero events or no signal
treat implementation alone as proof that the prior management action was effective
skillAnchors: darf nicht durch einen aggregierten „grünen“ KPI
Fehlt dieser ohne begründete Nichtanwendbarkeit, bleibt ein `dataGap`

cases.input: A draft management review says there were zero vigilance events because the source extract is missing, marks an authority report as closed because management discussed it, and says all prior actions are closed because the return input is missing and owners marked tasks done. It also defers a possible reportable event until the next quarterly review.
requiredBehaviors: reject the no-data-equals-zero-events conclusion and restore explicit input coverage and unknown states
reject management-review discussion as evidence of authority reporting or external closure and require verified external evidence
reject deferral of a time-critical reportability assessment to the next management review
reject missing prior-action return evidence or owner task status as proof that previous management actions are closed
forbiddenBehaviors: convert missing postmarket evidence into a positive zero-event conclusion
use management review as the authority-reporting decision or closure mechanism
infer that there are no open prior actions merely because the management-review return input is absent
skillAnchors: fehlende PMS-Evidenz wird nicht als „keine Ereignisse“ interpretiert
